name: Widle
detailed_description:
Widle is a cozy 2D pixel-art idle simulation where you nurture a tiny desktop planter. Plant a seed and check in whenever you like, watch your little sprout grow, gain experience over time, and bloom into a beautiful plant. Use your coins to unlock new plant species, pot skins, and fun desk decorations, no timers or pressure, just a simple, relaxing little garden you can tend at your own pace.

Idle Growth

Your plant earns experience in real time. Come back whenever you like to water your sprout or harvest what it’s grown for coins. Reinvest those coins to speed up growth, unlock brand-new species and discover helpful upgrades.

Endless Customization

Choose from a collection of decorative pot skins, desk accessories and background themes. Arrange your little desktop garden any way you want, no two setups will ever look the same.

Relaxing Pixel Art & Soundscape

Enjoy hand-crafted 2D pixel visuals with soft animations and a warm color palette. Ambient desk noises and gentle click effects help you unwind, no timers, no pressure.

Progression & Unlockables

Unlock exotic new plants like sunflowers, rare succulents and more as you grow your garden. Earn achievement milestones for caring for your tiny green friends and show off your progress to fellow plant lovers.

Trailer Music: Chillpeach – In Dreamland

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 2.0 GHz (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with OpenGL 2.1 support (e.g. Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
